prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide, not a background asset and not a collage.
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 presentation slide for the process page.
Communication purpose: 说明一次客服请求从接入、理解、检索和执行到回复、转人工及持续优化的完整路径
Single claim: AI 客服不是单点问答，而是一条可治理的服务闭环
Audience: 产品负责人、客服运营、解决方案架构师与研发团队
Art direction: restrained executive presentation with calm confidence and generous negative space
Composition/framing: asymmetric editorial grid, conclusion first, one strong visual anchor, precise alignment. short headline at upper-left or lower-left, supporting copy directly below, generous clear margin.
Frozen layout plan: text safe zone = top 18% reserved for the conclusion headline; all labels stay inside quiet matte fields with wide inner padding; visual zone = middle 62% for a left-entry, center-hub, right-parallel-capabilities topology; lower-middle for the human-agent branch; bottom 12% for the operations-and-governance rail and controlled feedback loop; hierarchy = conclusion headline > intelligent-orchestration hub > surrounding capability groups > component labels > directional connectors; density = medium; six primary groups, no more than five component labels per group, one governance rail, one feedback loop.
Scene and visual brief: A clean 16:9 hub-and-spoke systems architecture diagram. User touchpoints and unified access enter from the left. Intelligent orchestration is the central hub. Knowledge and tools plus model services sit as two parallel capabilities on the right, both called bidirectionally by orchestration. Human agents form a separate collaboration branch below the hub with explicit context handoff. A restrained operations-and-governance rail spans the system, while quality signals return to orchestration and knowledge through a controlled feedback loop. Use clear grouped nodes, directional lines, generous spacing, and one dominant service-flow path. No dashboard cards, no decorative circuit-board wallpaper, no fabricated metrics.
Imagery: credible contemporary workplace or architectural photography with natural light
Color palette: warm off-white, near-black, muted forest green, restrained amber accent
Materials/textures: matte paper, subtle rules, crisp image crops
Theme anchors: thin forest-green conclusion rule; large quiet margins; small restrained page marker

Typography: make the headline large enough for a projector; use a coherent Chinese font pairing; keep line breaks intentional and do not shrink text to fit.
Text safety: high text contrast; background behind text must be quiet, flat, or softly darkened; no face, object, highlight, grid, or light path may pass behind the letters.
Information boundary: use only the supplied visible text; do not invent metrics, labels, citations, UI, logos, product screens, names, dates, or claims.
Constraints: render the complete slide as one finished image; preserve a clear visual hierarchy; keep generous margins; use one dominant visual anchor; no editable UI; no watermark; no logo.
Avoid: glossy gradients; dashboard cards; blue corporate stock style; oversized decoration; extra words; misspelled Chinese; gibberish; tiny labels; dense card grids; busy detail behind text; decorative pseudo-data.
Continuity anchor: service-loop; continuity group: ai-customer-service-architecture.
